summary: Iteration 25 (report file iteration_18) — full backend + frontend verification of MFA nudge banner, MFA setup wiring, Owner Payment Links dashboard (summary cards, filters, refresh-from-Stripe, email/copy/archive row actions) and the Owner.jsx 4-file split. 15/15 pytest backend tests passed (new file test_iter25_mfa_payments.py). All frontend flows verified end-to-end in Playwright against the preview URL. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Dead logic: `was_paid` is computed after already-paid sessions are skipped (`continue`), so it is always False — newly_paid is still correct, but the variable is redundant/misleading.
Each call mints a brand-new secret and overwrites the pending one; a user mid-enrolment who reloads the page silently invalidates their previously scanned QR. Cosmetic/expected but worth noting.

issues: pl-monthly-totals bar chart only renders when summary.months.length > 1, so a single month of paid revenue (the common early case) shows no chart at all — could not be visually verified because there are 0 paid links in test mode.
'This month' summary card shows hint '—' when there is no paid revenue; a 'no paid links yet' label would read better.
'Expires on' uses the browser-native date input rendering mm/dd/yyyy (US format) on a UK-only product; a shadcn calendar / dd/mm/yyyy would be consistent (pre-existing).

action_items: Optional: render the monthly-totals chart when there is >=1 paid month (currently hidden until 2 months exist).
Optional: remove the dead `was_paid` branch in owner_refresh_payment_links.
critical_code_review_comments: Owner.jsx is now 171 lines and cleanly delegates to /pages/owner/{BusinessPanel,PromoCodesPanel,PaymentLinksPanel,DpaAcceptancesPanel}.jsx — all four tabs verified working, no regression.

MfaNudgeBanner correctly guards on staff roles, only renders when /auth/mfa/status returns enabled=false, and writes a 24h epoch to localStorage (measured exactly 24.0h). Banner is absent on public/logged-out pages.

PaymentLinksPanel filtering/summary are pure client-side useMemo derivations from GET /owner/billing/payment-links — counts verified consistent with API (0 paid / 5 pending / 1 active / 4 archived at test time).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test payment links via API+UI: 'TEST_iter25 bespoke licence' (£3,000, archived by test) and 'TEST_iter25 UI created licence' (£1,234.50, mat_1_5, archived via UI archive action). Both left archived — no paid Stripe sessions created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this iteration: (1) mfa-nudge-banner shows for owner AND school_admin on /dashboard and /owner, absent on public /login and /pricing; mfa-nudge-cta navigates to /mfa; mfa-nudge-dismiss hides it and persists localStorage 'learnify_mfa_nudge_dismissed_until' = now+24h, survives reload; clearing the key brings the banner back. (2) /mfa → 'Set up MFA' renders QR img + mfa-secret (32-char base32); POST /api/auth/mfa/setup returns secret + otpauth:// URI and does NOT flip enabled=true. (3) pl-summary cards render with GBP 2-dp formatting; pl-filter all/active/archived/paid/unpaid filter the table correctly (archived filter showed only the 4 archived rows, active showed 0 archived). (4) pl-copy-{id} writes the checkout URL to clipboard; pl-email-{id} + pl-email-last hrefs are mailto: with cc=schoollearnsupport%40pm.me and the checkout URL in the body; pl-archive-{id} works and the row leaves the active filter. (5) pl-refresh-stripe → POST /api/owner/billing/payment-links/refresh 200 {checked:1,newly_paid:0,errors:0}, toast 'Refreshed 1 link · 0 newly paid'; non-owner 403, unauth 401/403. (6) Regressions OK: link creation returns cs_test_ checkout URL, promo tab shows HWA26, DPA tab loads + acceptances.csv returns text/csv, /billing/checkout basic plan returns checkout.stripe.com URL, /pricing shows Individuals + schools contact card and no 'Test mode' text, /owner blocked for school_admin. No console errors observed. Unverified: pl-monthly-totals chart (needs >=2 months of PAID links; none exist in test mode).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects requiring RCA. Initial Playwright failure was a wrong selector on my side (login inputs are login-email-input / login-password-input, not name=identifier) — fixed in the test script.
